_meta.title: Who holds the federal debt
_meta.source: US Treasury Debt to the Penny (public vs intragovernmental, 7 Aug 2026); Treasury International Capital, Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities (foreign holdings, November 2025)
notes: Foreign holders are about 30% of publicly held debt. That is about $9.6T of the $32.14T held by the public, which is 24% of the $39.88T gross. A 32% figure is the share of publicly held debt wearing the gross label; the two denominators are not interchangeable.

Treasury International Capital is revised monthly and the release month is part of the figure. This dataset pins the November 2025 release, where China reads $683.9B; the same series reads $760.8B for January 2025.
Federal Reserve holdings are reported between $4.53T and $4.9T across sources; omitted rather than pick one.

refresh.reason: foreign holdings fetched from Treasury International Capital, Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities, at the release month pinned in curated/snapshots.yaml; the public versus intragovernmental split, the total and the foreign share history are curated from Debt to the Penny and carry their own as_of
